intro.h2: Remodeling that fits your needs and your budget
paragraphs: R&E Remodeling LLC takes on bathroom remodeling in Gaithersburg, MD, along with basements and other projects around the house. Customers tend to talk about Roger first. One homeowner says he understood both her needs and her budget and was creative in finding ways to get her what she needed at a price she could afford.

Another family had a complete basement remodel with a full bathroom done and says they wish they had found Roger years earlier for their other bathroom remodels. Reviewers also mention the details: the crew arrives on time, works thoroughly and leaves the house cleaner than when they came in.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: A remodeled bathroom changes how a house works every day. We plan the room around how you use it and what you want to spend, and we explain the options as we go. One family who hired us for a basement bath wishes they had called us for their earlier bathroom remodels too.

about.text: R&E Remodeling LLC is a remodeling contractor serving homeowners in Gaithersburg, MD. Roger is the name you will hear most from our customers. He works alongside a partner and a crew, and reviewers describe him as professional, knowledgeable, cordial and easy to talk to. Our reviews go back about ten years and cover bathroom and basement remodels as well as urgent repairs. The same idea runs through all of them: listen first, find a way to fit the budget, then do careful work and leave the house clean. We are open weekdays from 9 AM to 5 PM.
about.owner_role: Named in reviews as the person customers work with; full name and title not stated on Google (works with a partner and a crew)

process.h2: Working with R&E, step by step

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.text: Call (240) 774-0251, Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, and describe the room or the problem you want solved.

steps.title: Meet with Roger
steps.text: Roger meets with you to understand your needs and your budget, then looks for practical ways to get you what you need.

steps.title: Agree on the plan
steps.text: We go over the work and the price together, and you decide what makes sense for your home before anything starts.

steps.title: Careful, on-time work
steps.text: The crew arrives on time, works thoroughly, keeps you informed and takes care of the extra details along the way.

steps.title: A clean finish
steps.text: We walk the finished space with you and leave your home as clean as we found it, which reviewers say is often cleaner.

items.name: Valerie L.
items.text: I really enjoyed working with Roger at R&E Remodeling. He was professional, knowledgeable, but more than that, he had an understanding of my needs and my budget and was creative in figuring out the best ways I could get what I needed at a price I could afford. He and his crew were professional, clean, conscientious and timely. They arrived on time, worked diligently and thoroughly and left my home cleaner than when they came in. They took care of extra details and went the extra mile. I would definitely call on R&E Remodeling in the future!

items.name: Adriane
items.text: Roger was extremely cordial and very willing to assist us in our needs. The project was needed to be completed and corrected ASAP in order to protect our backyard. He and his partner met with us on Sunday and completed the project on Tuesday with no glitches. He was very fair with his price. He is extremely professional and friendly. Will definitely be obtaining his services in the near future. Have also told my neighbors.

items.name: Justin Z.
items.text: Roger and his crew did quality work, and really care about the outcome of the project. We had a complete basement remodel with full bathroom done and we are extremely happy with how it turned out. I wish we would have found Roger years ago to do our other bathroom remodels. Roger is very professional and maintains excellent communication- which was key to my family being happy with his work. Thanks again Roger!

service_area.text: R&E Remodeling LLC works with homeowners in Gaithersburg, Maryland. If you live in a nearby town and want to know whether your project is in range, the fastest way to find out is a quick call to (240) 774-0251 on a weekday between 9 AM and 5 PM. Share your address and a short description of the job, whether it is a bathroom, a basement or a repair, and we will let you know.

items.a: Yes. Bathroom work is a regular part of our projects, including a full bathroom built as part of a complete basement remodel. One family says they wish they had found Roger years ago for their other bathroom remodels. Call us to talk through the bathroom you have and the one you want.

items.q: Can you work with my budget?
items.a: We try to. One homeowner says Roger understood her needs and her budget and was creative in figuring out how she could get what she needed at a price she could afford. Tell us your range up front and we will talk honestly about what fits inside it.

When a job truly cannot wait, call us. In one case Roger and his partner met a homeowner on a Sunday about a project that had to be corrected quickly to protect their backyard, and they finished it on Tuesday with no glitches and a fair price.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (240) 774-0251 during those hours, or use the estimate form on this page to send a short description of your project and a few photos of the space.

items.q: Will my house be left clean?
items.a: Reviewers describe our crew as professional, clean, conscientious and timely, and one says we left her home cleaner than when we came in. The same review mentions that the crew took care of extra details and went the extra mile before the job was done.

final_cta.text: Call Roger and the R&E crew to plan a remodel that fits your home and your budget.
